title: Lecturer on Restorative Dentistry and Biomaterials Sciences
bio: Dr. Richard Liu is a lecturer in restorative dentistry and biomaterials in prosthodontics at the Harvard School of Dental Medicine. He earned his DMD from the University of Pennsylvania School of Dental Medicine and completed his prosthodontic specialty training at HSDM, where he also received a Master of Medical Sciences (MMSc). Liu has served as a part-time faculty member in the Department of Restorative Dentistry and Biomaterials Sciences since 2005.
